mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.permission_code
SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.role_code
